description: This Kotlin source file defines a LocationHandler class and related interfaces for managing device location data within an Android app. It includes permission checks, location fetching with timeout handling, and parameter parsing for location requests.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking permissions and fetching location data.

classes.name: DefaultLocationDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of LocationDataSource that uses LocationCaptureManager to fetch location.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling location requests, permission validation, and managing location fetching logic.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission.

methods.name: hasCoarseLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION permission.

methods.name: handleLocationGet
methods.description: Main method to process location requests, handle permission checks, choose providers, parse parameters, and manage errors.

methods.name: parseLocationParams
methods.description: Parses JSON string parameters to extract maxAgeMs, timeoutMs, and desiredAccuracy.
